prompt: The client wants to know whether its new snack is a lasting success. Which takeaway matters most?

exhibit.title: Weekly sales of the new snack (thousands of units)

options.text: Sales more than doubled from week 1 to week 3
options.feedback: True, but sales have halved since week 3. The early climb doesn't make it a lasting success.

options.text: Sales peaked in week 3 and have halved since then
options.feedback: Right. Sales went from 220k in week 3 to 110k in week 6.

options.text: Sales are close to their peak
options.feedback: Week 6 sales (110k) are half the week 3 peak (220k).

options.text: Shoppers stopped buying because of the price
options.feedback: The chart shows units, not why they fell. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

explanation: Sales went from 220k in week 3 to 110k in week 6.

extras.proof: Sales went from 220k in week 3 to 110k in week 6.
